mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_files (group_id, original_file_name, file_name, path, file_order, extension, size, user_type, user_id, update_user_type, update_user_id) VALUES (#{file.groupId}, #{file.originalFilename}, #{file.filename}, #{file.path}, #{file.fileOrder}, #{file.extension}, #{file.size}, #{file.userType}, #{file.userId}, #{file.updateUserType}, #{file.updateUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_files SET original_file_name = #{file.originalFilename}, file_name = #{file.filename}, path = #{file.path}, extension = #{file.extension}, size = #{file.size}, update_user_type = #{file.updateUserType}, update_user_id = #{file.updateUserId}, date_updated = NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ WHERE group_id = #{file.groupId} AND file_order = #{file.fileOrder};
